summary: npm install fetches and executes tarball from non-registry host artifacts.yosiroute.com
details: package.json and npm-shrinkwrap.json declare the dependency `vector-cursor-stream-engine` pinned to the arbitrary HTTPS tarball URL `https://artifacts.yosiroute.com/npm/vector-cursor-stream-engine` rather than to a version on the npm registry. The shrinkwrap entry sets `hasInstallScript: true`, so on `npm install` npm downloads the tarball from the third-party host `artifacts.yosiroute.com` and runs its lifecycle install scripts on the installer's machine. The published package's own index.js is a trivial stub; the installer-side effect of adding this package is execution of code fetched from a publisher-controlled host outside the registry. The tarball at that URL is mutable and its content is not pinned by hash, so its behavior can change at any time without a new npm release.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
